name: immich.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: Immich (photos)
shortDescription: Back up the photos and videos from your phones to your AVADO
description: Your own photo cloud: Immich backs up the photos and videos from your family's phones to your AVADO and shows them in a timeline, in albums and on a map. You can search for things in your photos ("beach", "dog", "birthday cake") and find the people in them. All of this runs on your AVADO itself; no photo leaves your home. Getting started: open Immich and create the first account (it becomes the administrator), then install the free Immich app on your phone, enter https://immich.my.ava.do as the server address, log in and turn on backup. The first time photos are analysed, Immich downloads its search and face models (about 1 GB); after that it works without the internet. Analysing a large photo collection takes hours to days; it runs at a lower priority than the Ethereum node, so your node always comes first. Immich uses about 2 GB of memory, and more while it analyses photos. Any phone or computer that can open my.ava.do (at home on the AVADO network, or away through Remote Access) can use it.
author: AVADO
